$comment: Corrections applied to the web copy of the geniura-api contract. Each entry documents real server behaviour verified against geniura-api dev@239ebd9 (view source + live responses from a local, unmodified instance). They must be fixed upstream in geniura-api; once fixed, the entry is removed here.

paginatedLists.$comment: Views that call StandardPagination.get_paginated_response() but whose schema says `type: array`. Real body: {count, next, previous, results}.

vocabularyLists.$comment: Taxonomy views return {count, results, locale} (no next/previous), while the schema says `type: array`.

errorEnvelope.$comment: apps/common/exceptions.py returns {code, message, details, request_id} for every error, but no component schema or 4xx response is declared. Added as ErrorResponse + a `default` response on every operation.

excludedPathPrefixes.$comment: Internal Geniura staff and audit surface: not used by the public web app and not published in this public repository.
